question: Which country is set to host the COP32 Climate Summit in 2027, as agreed in principle during the COP30 conference in Brazil?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ethiopia.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Ethiopia is set to be confirmed as the host of the COP32 Climate Summit in 2027, following an agreement in principle during COP30 held in Belem, Brazil.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 2027 COP32 summit will be held in Addis Ababa, the capital of Ethiopia.**
 
• Ethiopia’s bid was launched in September 2025 and later unanimously endorsed by the Bureau of African Countries, defeating Nigeria’s competing proposal.
 
• The final formal adoption of Ethiopia as host is expected shortly during COP30 proceedings.
 
• COP summits rotate among regional groups; COP32 falls under the African region’s turn.
 
• **COP30 (2025) is hosted by Brazil in Belem, while COP31 (2026) host is undecided — with Australia and Turkey both in contention.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **COP (Conference of the Parties):**__

 __
 
• Annual UN conference where nations negotiate global climate policies under the UNFCCC (United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change).
 
• Previous editions include COP28 (UAE, 2023) and COP29 (Azerbaijan, 2024).
 
 
 
• **Host Rotation:**__
 __
 
• Regional rotation ensures global representation — Africa, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, Western Europe, and Eastern Europe take turns hosting.
 
 
 
• **André Corrêa do Lago:**__ President of COP30 (Brazil) who confirmed Ethiopia’s selection and urged Western countries to finalize the COP31 host.
 
• __**Potential COP31 Hosts:**__ Australia (in partnership with Pacific Islands) and Turkey remain the main contenders; if unresolved, Bonn (Germany) may host by default.
